parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The ID of the GA instance whose port mapping table you want to query.

parameters.name: EndpointGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint group whose port mapping table you want to query.

parameters.name: ListenerId
parameters.description: The ID of the listener whose port mapping table you want to query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.
